## Map

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center

library(leaflet)

df <- read.csv("~/Documents/ATI_website/Data/masterdf.csv")

df_subset <- data.frame(
  lng  = df$Longitude,
  lat  = df$Latitude,
  poc  = df$Pocillopora_bleaching,
  acro = df$Acropora_bleaching,
  site = df$Site
)

# Shared domain across BOTH genera
shared_domain <- range(
  c(df_subset$poc, df_subset$acro),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = shared_domain,
  na.color = "transparent"
)

metadata <- paste0(
  "Site ", df_subset$site,
  "<hr>Pocillopora bleaching: ", round(df_subset$poc, 2), "%",
  "<hr>Acropora bleaching: ", round(df_subset$acro, 2), "%"
)

leaflet(df_subset) %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 12) %>%
  
  # Pocillopora layer
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    color = ~pal(poc),
    radius = 4,
    opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = metadata,
    group = "Pocillopora"
  ) %>%
  
  # Acropora layer
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    color = ~pal(acro),
    radius = 4,
    opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = metadata,
    group = "Acropora"
  ) %>%
  
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Pocillopora", "Acropora"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  
  # Single shared legend
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = shared_domain,
    title = "Bleaching (%)",
    opacity = 1
  )

```
